releaseNotes:
- Android Notice: This update requires a manual reinstall on Android devices. Please uninstall your existing Plix app and download the new release from https://plix.jman100.com
- Playback Overlay Auto-Hide: Fixed nested modal state so playback controls reliably auto-hide after searching, downloading, or dismissing subtitles
- Series Navigation Fix: Fixed 'Go to series' button during playback jumping focus off-screen, landing cursor cleanly on Resume/Play with smooth directional navigation across seasons and episodes
- Plex Subtitle & Audio Stream Parsing: Resolved stream iteration bug allowing all audio tracks and embedded/downloaded subtitle streams to be parsed and rendered cleanly
- Jellyfin Subtitle Organization: Categorized external and embedded subtitle streams to ensure downloaded subtitles do not shift existing tracks or result in wrong-index playback
- Subtitle Accented Characters (UTF-8): Added byte-order mark (BOM) inspection and strict UTF-8 decoding to fix garbled accented letters across all subtitle sources
- Jellyfin Transcoding Playback Resume: Fixed Jellyfin HLS transcode seeking to 0, ensuring playback continues seamlessly from current position
- Continue Watching Custom Order: Prioritized Continue Watching items to match user-configured favorite library sorting
- Mobile Recently Added Section Headings: Restyled server badge labels with a smaller, secondary font to prevent title truncation on mobile screens
- Category Filter & Default Focus: Transformed category filter into a scrolling sliver to prevent sticky header occlusion, defaulting focus to selected category and sort choices
- Jellyfin Library Refresh: Added instant cache-bypass when tapping refresh on Jellyfin library pages
- Episode Detail Cast Photos: Enforced standard 2:3 portrait aspect ratio for episode cast cards matching the overlay UI
- CI/CD macOS Runner: Updated iOS workflow runner to macos-latest
- App Version Bump: v1.8.1 (versionCode 43)
